stories.headline: Anthropic opens IPO books, revealing costs and risks
stories.summary: Anthropic published its IPO filing, reporting a large accounting-driven net loss alongside a much smaller operating loss and rapid growth. Offering terms remain undisclosed; the filing is not a completed stock-market debut.

stories.headline: Nvidia invests $3 billion in Meta AI partnership
stories.summary: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering as the firms deepen work on Muse models and agents. They aim to improve performance and lower costs; the announcement does not establish independent performance or safety gains.

stories.headline: Crypto spends $176 million across midterm races
stories.summary: Reuters reports crypto groups have spent about $176 million across more than 100 races to build bipartisan congressional support. The spending shows the industry's political strategy, not proof that it will secure its preferred laws.

stories.headline: Bolsonaro's party recognizes Lula's Brazil victory
stories.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro's party acknowledged Lula's runoff victory, although its candidate sought annulment. Trump alleged the election looked rigged without evidence; Lula's margin exceeds four million votes.

stories.headline: Regional powers agree to continue Iran talks
stories.summary: Iran, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan agreed to continue security dialogue after talks in Tehran. Houthi attacks and threats of renewed US–Iran fighting persist; no comprehensive ceasefire or settlement was announced.
